chunks: Can a man gesture during salat (prayer)? He said: "Yes. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله gestured in one of the mosques of the Ansar with a miḥjan that was with him."
Ḥanān said: "And I only know it to have been the mosque of Banū ʿAbd al-Ashhal."

key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: the Ansar, the Helpers of Madinah
key_terms.بِمِحْجَنٍ: with a miḥjan, a curved staff or hook-ended stick
key_terms.حَنَانٌ: Ḥanān, the narrator reporting the exchange
key_terms.يُومِئُ: to gesture or indicate by motion

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to gesture with one's hand or an object during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the permissibility of making a gesture during salat (prayer) when needed. The Imam عليه السلام supports this ruling by citing the practice of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, who gestured in a mosque of the Ansar with a curved staff or hook-like stick.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1076 - Hanan ibn Sadeer asked him: "Can a man gesture while praying?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes, the Prophet (sw) gestured in one of the mosques of the Ansar with a Muḥjan that he had with him."
Hanan said: "And I do not know except that it was the mosque of the Banu Abd al-Ashhal."
